studies.title: H1 — Scarcity and cooperation (inverted U)

contrasts.text: Cooperation is higher at richness 0.7 than at 1.3.
Cooperation is higher at richness 0.7 than at 0.4.

studies.note: Planner agents, institutions off. Falsified if either interval includes zero or has the opposite sign.

studies.title: H2 — Mobility and specialization

contrasts.text: Doubling the cost of movement raises the specialization index.

studies.note: Falsified if the paired difference is ≤ 0 or its interval includes zero.

studies.title: H3 — Communication range and adoption

contrasts.text: More runs reach E2 when voices carry nine tiles than when they carry two.

studies.note: Institutions by grammar search. Falsified if the paired difference in the E2 indicator is ≤ 0 or its interval includes zero.

studies.title: H4 — Diversity and resilience

contrasts.text: After the same blight on day 16, more people survive where temperaments and skills vary more.

studies.note: Both conditions receive an identical blight on day 16. Falsified if the paired difference is ≤ 0 or its interval includes zero.

studies.title: H5 — Cadence has diminishing returns

contrasts.text: Welfare at cadence 48 is at least 90% of welfare at cadence 12.
…with at most 35% as many deliberations (the check that the treatment was applied).

studies.note: The planner's clock is `planEvery`; between deliberations people act on reflex. Falsified if the lower 95% bound of the welfare ratio is below 0.90.

studies.title: H6 — Do institutions have anything to do? (The Long Winter)

contrasts.text: Positive control: a charter written by the designers raises survival.
Institutions found by non-LLM search change survival (no prediction of sign).

studies.note: H6a failing would mean institutional affordances are not materially useful in this world, and every E5 claim is moot.
